attachment_semantics.frame_1: Proxies visually align with original panel holes; native LED body and separate proxy are disconnected.
attachment_semantics.frame_80: All 40 LED lens proxies and 23 caps remain with lifted front panel, while native references move with PCB. This is a presentation error for the physical source construction.
attachment_semantics.frame_120: Panel and front proxies hidden; native board remains visible.

standoff_source_conflict.whole_LED_translation_rejected_reason: Whole-model lift also raises cut lead ends above PCB; full-width leads need a continuous installed reconstruction.

recommendations: Use one continuous PCB-mounted LED model per reference, with source-qualified spacer height and unthinned leads, rather than a separate red panel lens proxy.
Use clear lens appearance with red emitted light as supported by original source photos.
Keep PCB LEDs and switch caps associated with their PCB references in exploded views.
Keep original panel holes, board placement, LED polarity and cap opening geometry unchanged. Actual historical LED identity, fitted standoff and cap socket/travel remain qualified.
limitations: This review measured stable Blender6; later scene7 LED and cap invariance must be independently checked before applying these statements to the delivered later revision.
Generic LED dimensions are official installed library geometry, not a datasheet for the exact original supplied vendor.
Cap envelope overlap is not proof of hollow socket snap compatibility, actuator travel or physical tolerance clearance.
